
**This line is one of the paid layer campaign that [#1659](https://github.com/headwater-ai/headwater/issues/1659) asked for.** `tools/probe/campaign.sh` recorded it as line 2 of the plan of batch B, a plan that draws its lines from `tools/probe/layer-campaign.spec`. It is the absent arm of the campaign tier over the discovery selection, at 118 repetitions per probe, on `claude-sonnet-5` under Claude Code 2.1.288 with a cap of 80 turns for each session. The line leaves out `HW-PROBE-the-authoring-skill-reaches-an-agent-that-is-about-to-write-a-governed-document`, because no arm without `.claude/` can satisfy it.

**One tree.** Every session ran in a fresh copy of a `git archive` of commit `debe0c70`, with the engine of that commit. Batch B ran after batch A on the same pin that batch A ended on.

**What the recorder counted.** The line holds 354 sessions and cost 12736 cents. The intent hook was live in 0 of them. None stopped at the turn cap, and none at the session budget. The recorder reports 46 paths outside the workspace named in a call of this line, 0 sessions uncounted, and 0 web-tool calls.

**The contract of this batch.** The sessions ran under the recorder contract of spec 15: a `bwrap` sandbox with no network of its own, an empty configuration directory, `--setting-sources project,local`, the permission mode `dontAsk`, and `WebSearch` and `WebFetch` denied. The batches of 2026-09-28 and 2026-09-30 ran under `bypassPermissions` and the configuration of the host, so a rate from this batch does not compare with a rate from those batches.

**Where the figures are.** The rates, the intervals and the comparisons of this line are in the generated result that reads this transcript, and this document states none of them.
